reviews.text: They took great care of my little ones, Maru was always attentive to my messages, highly recommended
An excellent choice for my dogs, the best and the price seemed fair to me, I was amazed.
A great place to leave your pet, the owners are always looking after all the dogs, plus the staff is very dedicated and professional 🙌🏿🫶🏿

The best dog daycare in Mexico City! They always treat their dogs with warmth and love. It's like being at home. The customer service is wonderful; they answer all your questions, and both Maru and Isaac do an excellent job. Thank you, Casa Canino, for loving and caring so much for our dogs!
A place where I can confidently leave my pet and they take care of her like family. Excellent service, thank you all for taking care of Lula.

Looking for a place to board our pet where she wouldn't be in a cage all the time but would always have company and where her interactions would be supervised, we're so happy to have found Casa Canino. Every day we felt more at ease seeing her well cared for, settling in with the pack, and enjoying her stay. We know that if we need to again, we won't hesitate to board her with you :)
Excellent doggy daycare! My dogs are resistant to new places, but after a couple of weeks at Casa Canino, they happily run in to enjoy their daycare. Highly recommended!
